An '''alien''' guest was present at<ref name="SC 106" /> [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]]<ref name="Spa name">{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/bj8gqtnvm799njt6mjc6t|text=GR-FF-001420|date=2024-12-23}}</ref> on [[Lanupa]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. After a [[Silvo's pirates|group]] of [[pirate]]s attacked the [[hotel]]<ref name="SC 106" /> around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> they<ref name="Jasper's instagram" /> were gathered with a group of guests at the entrance of the hotel when the pirate [[Jod Na Nawood]] emerged from a hatch in the ground. They silently watched as Na Nawood and the [[droid]] [[SM-33]] were captured by the main group of pirates.<ref name="SC 106" />

==Behind the scenes==
This alien appeared in the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', with [[Jasper Anderson]] as a performance artist for the character.<ref name="SC 106" /> Anderson revealed in an [[Wikipedia:Instagram|Instagram]] post that the full body puppet was the same that was used for [[Gatha Elbaphay]] in the {{Film|VIII}}. Anderson had a video feed inside the suit since there was no other way to see out of the suit. Anderson controlled the head of the puppet with their left hand and that the face was controlled remotely by [[Mike Senna]].<ref name="Jasper's instagram">{{Instagram|username=jasperjandersonfx|url=p/DE8QDn6MZJi|name=[[Jasper Anderson]]|date=2025-01-17|quote=I got to play another fun creature in Skeleton Crew episode 6, a blubbery hunchbacked species credited as the Dowager Alien. This one is a full body puppet, a little like Big Bird, where my right hand is controlling the head, and my left is fully inside of the creature’s left arm. Droid supervisor @themikesenna is controlling the face via RC. It’s a lovely construction by the UK creature shop from The Last Jedi. I had a video feed from the camera to work off of, because otherwise it’s completely blind inside! She’s just a background character, but it was a lot of fun reacting to Jude Law’s space pirate antics with the other spa guests.|archiveurl=https://archive.vn/wa2vJ|archivefile=File:JasperAnderson-Dowager-IG.jpg}}</ref>
